raw_events.text: Static scene at start: dark blue upper background, green strip along the bottom, and a small light-grey/white square resting on the green at left-of-centre. No on-screen text. The square does not move in the frames shown.

Full-screen red flash. Centre text: "YOU DIED" - first on a dark red background in dark lettering, then on a bright red background in white lettering. Then the view returns to the static scene at ~50s.
Centre on-screen text appears on the unchanged background: "CHECKPOINT" - first dark green, then bright green. Then the text disappears and the static scene continues.
Object appears on the right side, mid-height: a yellow square with black text inside reading "KEY". The square then darkens and disappears. No other change to the scene.

Second full-screen red flash. Centre text: "YOU DIED" - first on a dark red background in dark lettering, then on a bright red background in white lettering. Then the view returns to the static scene.
Full-screen blue flash. Centre text: "PAUSED" - first on a dark blue background in grey lettering, then on a bright blue background in white lettering. Then the view returns to the static scene.
Centre on-screen text appears on the unchanged background: "LEVEL COMPLETE" - first in dull yellow, then in bright yellow. Then the text disappears.
Video ends on the same static scene as at the start. No other on-screen text, full-screen flashes, or appearing objects are seen.
No player sentences are heard at any point in the recording - there is no audible think-aloud speech to transcribe.
